fields.evidenceIndex: integer from the saved research evidence
fields.possibleRevealPatterns: one or more values allowed by the canonical reveal-pattern contract

fields.narrationBeats: exactly five canonical timed narration beats

fields.visualWorld: one coherent bright blue/cyan blueprint-grid explanation world
fields.recurringObjects: stable product, subject, and prop identities
fields.variants: exactly one variant with a six-frame storyboard; the canonical runner derives three shot records

rules: The agent may author creative planning content but may not invent factual claims.
The runner derives evidence-use metadata and canonical scene metadata.
The selected plan must preserve the selected direction's evidence index.
The canonical runtime rejects invalid scripts, timing, frames, shots, CTAs, reveal patterns, and unsupported claims.
No paid media call may run until the canonical scene passes validation.
